PLAN "3-Week Reconditioning — Return to Strength"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Restore pre-illness strength"

PHASES
  PHASE "Reconditioning" (3 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper - Reintroduction":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Lower - Reintroduction":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5..6 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full - Light Volume":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          deadlift 3x3..4 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          side_plank 3x30..45 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Upper - Build":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x5..6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower - Build":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x60..75 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full - Heavy-ish":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3..4 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          deadlift 4x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x30..45 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper - Intensify":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          bent_over_row 5x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          military_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 65m "Lower - Intensify":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 3x2..3 rpe 8 rest 210 seconds
          front_squat 3x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x45..60 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Full - Peak Prep":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x2..3 rpe 8..9 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 3x1..2 rpe 8..9 rest 240 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          russian_twist 3x20..30 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
